title: I'm making a browser-based idle RPG inspired by Shakes & Fidget and Hero Zero, and I'm looking for beta testers
author: ozeppo
selftext:
So, I've been working on a browser-based idle RPG called Haunt Hustle, inspired by games like Shakes & Fidget and Hero Zero, but with a slightly different setting and a more paranormal twist.

The idea is pretty simple: you're basically a freelance paranormal investigator taking random jobs around a small town. Except instead of fixing someone's plumbing or delivering packages, you're dealing with haunted toasters, possessed furniture, angry ghosts, and other questionable things.

Gameplay-wise, it's pretty much what you'd expect from this kind of game. You pick up timed contracts, fight enemies automatically, collect equipment, upgrade your character, and gradually unlock more stuff to do. There's also a ghost collection system, dungeons, and PvP battles.

I've been trying to keep the whole thing fairly lighthearted, with a bit of absurd humor rather than going for an actual horror atmosphere.

It's still a work in progress, and there's definitely plenty left to improve, but I'm getting to the point where I'd like to see how other people experience it.

I've just made the website public, and I'm currently looking for a small group of people interested in testing the game before its public release. The game itself isn't publicly playable yet, but you can apply for the closed beta through Discord.

Would love to hear what you guys think about the concept, especially if you've played Shakes & Fidget, Hero Zero, or similar browser RPGs!

Website: [https://haunthustle.com](https://haunthustle.com/)
